nusmp.skill.grimoire_anti_magic.descript: Grimoire magic: Anti-Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Every page is paid in Tensura aura, not in magicules.
nusmp.skill.book_anti_magic.description: The magic that is not magic. It costs no mana: every page is paid in Tensura aura (2% to 15% of your maximum aura, shown on Tensura's own aura bar), and if the aura is short the page fails with "Not enough aura". It cuts spells out of the air and strips enemies of their protections. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.demon_slayer_: Demon-Dweller Sword: Black Slash - a flying anti-magic slash that cuts spells out of its path and knocks its target back. Costs 2% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_divider: Demon-Slayer Sword: Black Divider - the flat of the blade bats spells back, then a huge sweep of condensed anti-magic strips magic from all it hits. Costs 4% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_meteori: Black Meteorite - coated in anti-magic, you charge the target and cut; spells in the way are cut too. Costs 6% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_hurrica: Black Hurricane - you spin, drawn toward the magic around you, and every spell and trap nearby is nullified. Costs 6% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_form: Black Asta - anti-magic courses through your body: far stronger and faster, magic near you erodes. Costs 12% of your aura; twice a day, a third time costs you. Once you have become the Anti-Magic Lord this page is Black Form: a held state that costs 3% of your aura to enter and 1.5% of your maximum aura every second, ends with a message when the aura runs out, and ends at once when you cast it again.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.bull_thrust: Bull Thrust - swords pointed ahead, you hurl yourself forward; every spell in front is dispelled on contact. Costs 3% of your aura.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.infinite_slas: Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash - a large anti-magic slash from overhead that cuts a 24-block line. Costs 5% of your aura.
Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash Equinox - a massive slash that travels very far and never harms your allies. Costs 15% of your aura.
nusmp.skill.anti_magic_spirit_lord.descr: You have no mana, and so magic has no hold on you. Your body runs on Tensura aura. Toggle Black Form to let it pour out: magic cannot touch you, your blade cuts deeper, and the form drains your aura every second until you end it or the aura runs dry. Anti-Magic Power is still gathered from every spell that strikes you, but it is only a record now; it pays for nothing.
